why: The only major reviewer (Popular Mechanics, plus its Yahoo copy) explicitly says it has not tested any power station for UPS switchover and gives no picks. One niche site (Outlet Powered) answers with a database of maker-claimed times and the Intel 12 ms benchmark but no measurements; the rest are concept explainers, a runtime calculator, an Anker brand blog, and four unreadable pages. Nobody names tested models that keep a gaming PC from rebooting, so a page with specific picks, measured or cart-checked data and current prices would stand out.
